description: This Java class defines a read-only label component for displaying integer sensor values in the UI. It listens to sensor updates and updates the label text accordingly.

classes.name: IntGaugeLabel
classes.description: A JLabel subclass that displays integer sensor values, updating dynamically as sensor data is received.

methods.name: IntGaugeLabel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the label with a sensor, ensuring it is of integer type, and sets up a listener to update the label text.
